environment: Chromium + isolated PostgreSQL/PGlite; real private RLS/RPC and rendered frontend; simulated Auth/AI only. Not live Supabase.

checks.name: anonymous home and direct article links show only the login gate without article RPC calls
password reveal supports keyboard and a failed login shows no private content
another registered account is refused and never requests article data
owner login retrieves 100 private articles, including former drafts
compact colored tags and header remain correct after privatization
scroll loads 100 then 43 more without public RPC calls
private article shows stored original text as plain text before analyses
fact/opinion colors remain green/red and mobile stacks without overflow
previous/next follows the current sorted private results and back retains loaded tags
same tab can open editor with its private session and no publish control
owner saves an unanalyzed private original and reads it from the library
logout immediately removes original, analysis, article titles and navigation handlers
session expiry relocks the reader and discards private data
a new independent browser tab starts at login
signing out in one tab also locks another signed-in tab
browser back-forward page lifecycle clears and rechecks private DOM
